item.title: We should all be using dependency cooldowns
item.description:
📝 TL;DR: Dependency cooldowns are a free, easy, and incredibly effective way to mitigate the large majority of open source supply chain attacks. Consequently, ordinary developers can avoid the bulk of these types of attacks by instituting cooldowns on their dependencies. They won’t stop all attackers, but they do stymie the majority of high-visibiity, mass-impact supply chain attacks that have become more common.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.yossarian.net/2025/11/21/We-should-all-be-using-dependency-cooldowns
